Operatives of the Lagos State Police Command have arrested a 34-year-old ex-convict, Adams Victor, in Ibadan, Oyo State, over alleged vehicle theft. Two vehicles suspected to have been stolen were recovered in the process. The command disclosed this in a statement by its Police Public Relations Officer, Abimbola Adebisi, on Sunday. Adebisi noted that the suspect was arrested following an investigation into a vehicle theft case reported in Lagos in May 2026. She added that the operatives extended their investigation beyond Lagos to Ibadan, where Victor was apprehended. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The Commissioner of Police, Lagos State Command, Fatai Tijani, commended the operatives for their diligence and determination in pursuing the investigation across state boundaries. Tijani assured residents that the command would sustain efforts to track down criminal networks, recover stolen property, and bring perpetrators to justice. He urged members of the public to report suspicious activities and provide useful information to the police.
